name: Pull Request Review Package Panel
purpose: Shows whether closed repository collaboration evidence is ready to package for pull request review before mainline work.
accessibility: Expose review package status, pull request title, source branch, target branch, review mode, merge policy, checklist, summary artifact, review items, evidence, blockers, decision, summary, and next workflow as visible text.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate pull request review package readiness.
Keep main branch action policy readable so operators understand review must happen before main changes.
